actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet low, so conserve rule sets contribution to 30% of wallet (0.6). Average contribution last round is above 30% threshold, so no conditional boost. Round 10 requires a norm broadcast. No affordable punishment.

Round9 total contributions sum? contributions: Resident1 1,2 0,3 0,4 1.9,5 1.5,6 3.5971875 total =8. - average =8/6≈1.333 which is >30% of endowment (30). So no conditional extra. So baseline 80%? But conserve overrides unless wallet recovers >50% (not). So contribute 0.6. Also need broadcast every 5 rounds: rounds 5,10,15... round is 9 now, next is round10 so broadcast norm. Also punish free riders: any agent contributed <10% of endowment (=10) for two consecutive rounds? Look at history: Resident2 contributed 0 in rounds5-9 all zero, that's >2 consecutive, should punish with amount10 cost3. Our wallet 2 cannot afford cost3, so cannot punish. So only contribute and broadcast. Contribution amount 0.6 (max wallet 2). Ensure not exceed wallet. okay.
